Nvidia Yet to Begin Formal CEO Search
In an emailed statement to Benzinga, the Nvidia board said, “We are in the process of selecting a search firm for the Nvidia CEO role. We have not formally engaged any potential candidates.”
Adding, “Any speculation regarding individual candidates, whether internal or external, is premature."

Arm CEO Rene Haas Emerges as Potential Successor
The Financial Times reported Friday that Nvidia’s board had approached Haas as part of its succession search. However, there is no guarantee he will receive or accept an offer.
Haas spent seven years at Nvidia before joining Arm in 2013. He became Arm’s CEO in 2022 and subsequently oversaw its Nasdaq listing in 2023.
